decision_policy.veto_rule: One confirmed veto fails visual integrity until the exact defect is repaired and re-reviewed in every affected state.
decision_policy.major_rule: One confirmed major defect blocks a clean pass. A documented product constraint may change its disposition only through the exception rule.
decision_policy.warning_rule: Warnings do not fail alone. Three converging warnings in one causal cluster become a major defect.
decision_policy.exception_rule: An exception is valid only when the marker's allowed_exception is satisfied, the reason is source-backed, required information remains usable, and the reviewer records located evidence across affected states.
decision_policy.taste_boundary: Personal dislike, fashion, novelty, minimalism, maximalism, symmetry, or asymmetry cannot fail an artifact without a listed defect or a separately reasoned taste-track judgment.
decision_policy.review_rule: Run machine checks where specified, then use strong native vision at whole-frame and detail scale. Machine checks cannot visually certify the artifact, and visual impression cannot override a measured hard failure.

markers.marker: Unintended element overlap or collision
markers.inspection: Compare rendered bounding boxes, stacking order, and pixels at every required viewport and state.
markers.fail_when: Required content, controls, labels, or evidence intersect in a way that obscures, merges, or changes their intended reading.
markers.allowed_exception: Intentional overlap is allowed only when source-backed, optically controlled, non-obscuring, and verified in every affected state.
markers.required_evidence: Viewport, state, selectors or regions, bounding boxes, and annotated screenshot.

markers.marker: Required content clipped by a container, mask, crop, or viewport
markers.inspection: Inspect edges and compare scroll, clip, mask, and overflow geometry with visible pixels.
markers.fail_when: Any required text, control, token specimen, label, chart mark, or proof value is partially or fully cut off.
markers.allowed_exception: Deliberate image cropping may pass when the focal subject and required evidence remain intact across states.
markers.required_evidence: Affected region, clipping ancestor, computed geometry, and close screenshot.

markers.marker: Unintended page or component overflow
markers.inspection: Measure scrollWidth against clientWidth and scrollHeight against intended bounds at all required viewports.
markers.fail_when: The document has unintended horizontal overflow or required content escapes its designated local scroll region.
markers.allowed_exception: A labeled local data scroller may pass when keyboard, touch, focus, and edge affordances are usable.
markers.required_evidence: Viewport dimensions, scroll measurements, offending selector, and screenshot.

markers.marker: Required information hidden behind another layer
markers.inspection: Review stacking, sticky elements, overlays, tooltips, dialogs, and fixed controls in every active state.
markers.fail_when: A required target or evidence region is entirely hidden or cannot be revealed without losing the current task state.
markers.allowed_exception: User-opened temporary content may cover background content when focus is contained and dismissal is clear.
markers.required_evidence: State sequence, obscuring layer, hidden region, and before-after screenshots.

markers.marker: Broken, missing, substituted, or undecodable asset
markers.inspection: Check load results and visually inspect every image, icon, font, video poster, and embedded resource.
markers.fail_when: An asset is missing, replaced by a broken indicator, silently substituted in a meaning-changing way, or fails to decode.
markers.allowed_exception: A declared fallback may pass only when it preserves meaning, layout, and required standalone behavior.
markers.required_evidence: Asset locator, load result, fallback result, and visible region.

markers.marker: Incorrect stacking or paint order
markers.inspection: Inspect layered regions, focus rings, popovers, sticky content, decorative layers, and masked edges.
markers.fail_when: An element appears in front of or behind another contrary to task order, interaction state, or visual grammar.
markers.allowed_exception: Source-backed depth ambiguity may pass when controls and required information remain unambiguous.
markers.required_evidence: Layer list, affected regions, state, and close screenshot.

markers.marker: Broken mask, crop edge, transparency seam, or antialiasing artifact
markers.inspection: Zoom into masked, clipped, composited, and transparent edges on light and dark backgrounds.
markers.fail_when: Halos, seams, jagged edges, unintended holes, or subject loss are visible at intended size.
markers.allowed_exception: Deliberately rough edges may pass only when repeated as a source-backed material language.
markers.required_evidence: Magnified region, intended size region, background variants, and rationale.

markers.marker: Unexpected layout jump or unstable placement
markers.inspection: Observe load, font resolution, image decode, expansion, and state transitions while recording geometry.
markers.fail_when: Content shifts enough to lose reading position, cause accidental activation, or create a visibly unstable composition.
markers.allowed_exception: User-triggered expansion may move content when the motion is predictable and focus remains anchored.
markers.required_evidence: Before-after frames, shift measurements, trigger, and affected task.

markers.marker: Unexplained alignment drift
markers.inspection: Overlay shared axes and compare left, right, center, cap-height, and baseline alignments across related elements.
markers.fail_when: Elements intended to share an axis visibly miss it and no semantic or optical reason explains the difference.
markers.allowed_exception: Optical correction may pass when its purpose is visible and repeated consistently.
markers.required_evidence: Alignment guides, regions, measured offsets, and optical rationale if used.

markers.marker: Inconsistent internal spacing without role or content cause
markers.inspection: Measure padding within repeated components and compare by anatomy, state, and content length.
markers.fail_when: Like components use visibly different padding that creates drift, crowding, or false hierarchy.
markers.allowed_exception: Content- or state-driven variation may pass when governed by a named rule and applied consistently.
markers.required_evidence: Component set, padding values, states, and governing rule.

markers.marker: Required content crowded against frame or container edges
markers.inspection: Inspect breathing room at every outer and inner edge, including narrow states and long content.
markers.fail_when: Text, controls, or evidence appear accidentally pinned, visually cut, or difficult to target because clearance is insufficient.
markers.allowed_exception: Edge-to-edge media may pass when cropping is intentional and overlays retain safe clearance.
markers.required_evidence: Affected edges, distances, state, and screenshot.

markers.marker: Detached label, divider, caption, control, or decorative element
markers.inspection: Trace visual grouping and proximity relationships at whole-frame and detail scale.
markers.fail_when: An element appears to belong to no region or to the wrong region because position and grouping conflict.
markers.allowed_exception: Deliberate tension may pass when source-backed and still yields one unambiguous association.
markers.required_evidence: Element, candidate groups, proximity relations, and association finding.

markers.marker: Accidental spatial imbalance
markers.inspection: Review visual mass, whitespace, focal distribution, and edge pressure at thumbnail and intended size.
markers.fail_when: One region feels unintentionally heavy or empty and the imbalance weakens hierarchy or grouping.
markers.allowed_exception: Deliberate imbalance may pass when it advances reading order or source-specific expression.
markers.required_evidence: Whole-frame screenshot, mass map, and purpose test.

markers.marker: Spacing rhythm has unexplained one-off gaps or near-duplicates
markers.inspection: Cluster measured gaps and compare clusters with semantic boundaries and hierarchy levels.
markers.fail_when: Near-equal gaps create noise, or a large or small gap signals a false relationship.
markers.allowed_exception: Optical and content adjustments may pass when their relationship remains clear and repeatable.
markers.required_evidence: Gap clusters, semantic boundaries, outliers, and reviewer finding.

markers.marker: Element appears to float without anchor
markers.inspection: Check whether position, connector, container, baseline, or proximity provides a stable association.
markers.fail_when: A control, note, mark, or visual has no clear anchor and can be mistaken for another region's content.
markers.allowed_exception: Free-floating expressive elements may pass when they are noninteractive, nonsemantic, and compositionally controlled.
markers.required_evidence: Element region, candidate anchors, and association test.

markers.marker: Geometric proportions contradict intended anatomy
markers.inspection: Compare component dimensions, aspect ratios, line weights, and recurring shapes against the source and token rules.
markers.fail_when: A component is visibly stretched, compressed, undersized, oversized, or proportionally inconsistent without intent.
markers.allowed_exception: Responsive transformation may pass when a named anatomy rule changes the proportion and preserves function.
markers.required_evidence: Dimensions, source or token rule, state, and comparison image.

markers.marker: Text is unreadable at intended viewing size
markers.inspection: Inspect all required text at 100 percent and expected viewing distance across supported displays.
markers.fail_when: Required characters cannot be reliably distinguished because of size, weight, blur, crop, texture, or rendering.
markers.allowed_exception: Purely decorative text may pass only when it conveys no information and is excluded from reading order.
markers.required_evidence: Text region, computed style or pixel dimensions, viewport, and readable transcription result.

markers.marker: Font fallback changes hierarchy or layout
markers.inspection: Compare first render, settled render, and offline render; inspect line breaks, metrics, and role differentiation.
markers.fail_when: Fallback causes clipping, overlap, different information density, or collapse of intended typographic contrast.
markers.allowed_exception: System-font design may pass when fallback order is intentional and tested on required platforms.
markers.required_evidence: Font resolution log, screenshots, line-break comparison, and platform set.

markers.marker: Line height causes collisions or impairs continuous reading
markers.inspection: Inspect ascenders, descenders, multi-line labels, paragraphs, and wrapped controls at all sizes.
markers.fail_when: Lines touch, glyphs collide, reading bands merge, or spacing is so loose that lines stop grouping.
markers.allowed_exception: Display typography may use tight or loose leading when short, noncritical, and optically controlled.
markers.required_evidence: Text sample, line-height value, length, role, and close screenshot.

markers.marker: Text measure is poorly matched to reading task
markers.inspection: Measure line length and review scan effort for paragraphs, labels, tables, code, and hashes separately.
markers.fail_when: Paragraph lines are persistently too long or too short for fluent reading, or data lines wrap into ambiguity.
markers.allowed_exception: Dense operational data and intentionally narrow editorial forms may pass with task-specific evidence.
markers.required_evidence: Character counts, content role, viewport, and reading-task rationale.

markers.marker: Typographic hierarchy contradicts information priority
markers.inspection: Compare size, weight, case, color, spacing, and position with the semantic outline and task order.
markers.fail_when: Lower-priority text visually outranks required headings, decisions, warnings, or evidence.
markers.allowed_exception: A deliberate teaser may pass only when it does not precede or obscure safety or decision-critical content.
markers.required_evidence: Semantic outline, visual rank order, and mismatched regions.

markers.marker: Excessive or inconsistent text styles
markers.inspection: Inventory computed typographic signatures and group them by semantic role.
markers.fail_when: Near-duplicate styles multiply without distinct roles or related roles use conflicting styles.
markers.allowed_exception: Expressive editorial systems may pass when every variation has a stable role and remains readable.
markers.required_evidence: Style inventory, role mapping, duplicates, and exceptions.

markers.marker: Tracking or word spacing damages recognition
markers.inspection: Inspect uppercase labels, small text, numerals, and long words for collisions or fragmented word shapes.
markers.fail_when: Characters collide, words break visually, or tracking makes labels slow or ambiguous to read.
markers.allowed_exception: Display lettering may pass when short, noncritical, and verified at final scale.
markers.required_evidence: Text sample, spacing values, role, and actual-size screenshot.

markers.marker: Numbers, units, code, or hashes are hard to compare
markers.inspection: Inspect column alignment, numeral forms, wrapping, separators, and unit placement in data-heavy regions.
markers.fail_when: Values cannot be compared reliably or wrap so that ownership, sign, unit, or precision becomes ambiguous.
markers.allowed_exception: Proportional numerals may pass outside comparative data when no ambiguity results.
markers.required_evidence: Data region, value examples, alignment behavior, and comparison task.

markers.marker: Text contrast below WCAG 2.2 AA minimum
markers.inspection: Compute contrast from rendered foreground and effective background for every text state.
markers.fail_when: Normal text is below 4.5 to 1 or large-scale text is below 3 to 1, excluding valid WCAG exceptions.
markers.allowed_exception: Only WCAG incidental, invisible, inactive, or logotype exceptions apply; thin or unusual fonts still require visual legibility review.
markers.required_evidence: Colors, effective background, ratio, text size and weight, state, and exception if any.

markers.marker: Required UI or graphic contrast below 3 to 1
markers.inspection: Compute adjacent-color contrast for controls, focus indicators, state boundaries, and essential graphic parts.
markers.fail_when: A required component or essential graphical distinction is below 3 to 1 against adjacent colors.
markers.allowed_exception: Inactive, decorative, or user-agent-controlled appearances may use the applicable WCAG exception.
markers.required_evidence: Component, adjacent colors, ratio, state, and semantic requirement.

markers.marker: Color is the only carrier of required meaning
markers.inspection: Review in grayscale and common color-vision simulations; remove hue while preserving luminance.
markers.fail_when: Status, selection, difference, error, or data category becomes indistinguishable without color.
markers.allowed_exception: Color may reinforce meaning when text, shape, pattern, position, or icon also carries it.
markers.required_evidence: Original, grayscale, simulation, and redundant cue.

markers.marker: Semantic color roles collide
markers.inspection: Compare success, warning, error, info, selected, disabled, focus, and neutral states in context.
markers.fail_when: Different meanings use indistinguishable appearance or one color conveys conflicting meanings in the same context.
markers.allowed_exception: Shared color may pass when another prominent cue makes the states unmistakable.
markers.required_evidence: State matrix, rendered samples, ratios, and redundant cues.

markers.marker: Transparency makes contrast or state unpredictable
markers.inspection: Calculate effective colors over every intended background and inspect during overlap and motion.
markers.fail_when: Text, controls, or evidence fall below required contrast or change meaning over allowed backgrounds.
markers.allowed_exception: Decorative translucent layers may pass when they never affect required content or controls.
markers.required_evidence: Foreground alpha, background variants, effective ratios, and screenshots.

markers.marker: Gradient, image, texture, or noise interferes with reading
markers.inspection: Inspect the lowest-contrast point beneath every text and control across responsive crops.
markers.fail_when: Background variation causes any required portion to lose legibility, boundary, or state clarity.
markers.allowed_exception: A stable scrim or local backing may pass when tested across all content and crops.
markers.required_evidence: Worst-point region, contrast sample, crop states, and backing method.

markers.marker: Required meaning disappears in forced-colors mode
markers.inspection: Render with forced colors or equivalent high-contrast substitution and inspect every state.
markers.fail_when: Controls, selection, focus, chart meaning, or content boundaries disappear or become misleading.
markers.allowed_exception: Decorative color may disappear when no information or interaction depends on it.
markers.required_evidence: Forced-color screenshot, state list, lost meanings, and repair method.

markers.marker: Light, dark, print, or mode palette is incomplete or mismatched
markers.inspection: Render every declared mode and compare semantic roles, contrast, imagery, and browser chrome integration.
markers.fail_when: A mode contains invisible, inverted, low-contrast, or semantically wrong elements.
markers.allowed_exception: A single-mode artifact may omit other modes when this is explicit and no system preference claim is made.
markers.required_evidence: Mode matrix, screenshots, ratios, and declared support.

markers.marker: Pointer target below WCAG 2.2 minimum without an exception
markers.inspection: Measure each target's rendered bounding box and spacing to neighboring targets.
markers.fail_when: A target cannot contain a 24 by 24 CSS pixel square and satisfies none of the spacing, equivalent, inline, user-agent, or essential exceptions.
markers.allowed_exception: Only the WCAG 2.2 Target Size Minimum exceptions apply and must be recorded per target.
markers.required_evidence: Target geometry, neighbor geometry, exception test, viewport, and state.

markers.marker: Keyboard focus is not visibly identifiable
markers.inspection: Traverse all interactive elements by keyboard and inspect focus appearance against adjacent colors.
markers.fail_when: Focus is missing, indistinguishable, clipped, or visually identical to the unfocused state.
markers.allowed_exception: No exception for author-created interactive elements that receive keyboard focus.
markers.required_evidence: Focus sequence, element, focused and unfocused screenshots, and contrast evidence.

markers.marker: Focused component is hidden by author-created content
markers.inspection: Keyboard through the page with sticky bars, dialogs, notices, menus, and overlays active.
markers.fail_when: The focused component is entirely hidden and cannot be revealed without advancing focus.
markers.allowed_exception: User-opened content may cover it when the focused item can be revealed without moving focus.
markers.required_evidence: Focus step, obscuring element, viewport, and screenshot.

markers.marker: Keyboard order conflicts with reading or task order
markers.inspection: Record focus sequence and compare it with visual order, DOM order, and task dependencies.
markers.fail_when: Focus jumps unpredictably, enters hidden content, skips required controls, or reaches controls before prerequisite context.
markers.allowed_exception: A different order may pass when it remains logical and preserves all task dependencies.
markers.required_evidence: Focus sequence, visual order, DOM order, and conflict locations.

markers.marker: Required information or action is available only on hover
markers.inspection: Operate with keyboard, touch, and no-hover media settings; inspect labels, tooltips, and revealed controls.
markers.fail_when: Required content or functionality cannot be reached, perceived, or dismissed without hover.
markers.allowed_exception: Hover may add redundant enhancement when all required content and actions have non-hover access.
markers.required_evidence: Input methods tested, hidden item, alternate access, and screenshots.

markers.marker: Reduced-motion preference is ignored
markers.inspection: Render and interact with reduced-motion enabled; compare transitions, parallax, auto-motion, and animated emphasis.
markers.fail_when: Nonessential motion persists, required content becomes unavailable, or disabling motion breaks layout or meaning.
markers.allowed_exception: Essential state change may remain when no less-motion equivalent can preserve the function.
markers.required_evidence: Preference state, motion inventory, before-after behavior, and essentiality rationale.

markers.marker: Flashing exceeds WCAG 2.2 safety threshold
markers.inspection: Measure luminance and red transitions over time at the largest supported presentation.
markers.fail_when: Content flashes more than three times in one second and is not below the general and red flash thresholds.
markers.allowed_exception: Only content below the normative general and red flash thresholds may pass.
markers.required_evidence: Frame sequence, flash rate, affected area, luminance data, and threshold result.

markers.marker: Programmatic reading order changes meaning
markers.inspection: Compare accessibility tree or DOM reading order with the visual narrative and proof dependencies.
markers.fail_when: Assistive reading presents content in an order that loses relationships, prerequisites, labels, or verdict context.
markers.allowed_exception: Visual and programmatic order may differ only when both remain independently logical and equivalent.
markers.required_evidence: Programmatic sequence, visual sequence, relationship map, and conflicts.

markers.marker: Horizontal page scrolling at a required reflow width
markers.inspection: Render at 320 CSS pixels and all required widths; compare document and viewport widths.
markers.fail_when: Two-dimensional scrolling is required for ordinary content outside valid content exceptions.
markers.allowed_exception: Parts that inherently require two-dimensional layout, such as large data tables or maps, may use a contained accessible scroller.
markers.required_evidence: Viewport, document width, scroller boundaries, and screenshot.

markers.marker: Text resize to 200 percent loses content or function
markers.inspection: Resize text to 200 percent without changing viewport and inspect every required region and control.
markers.fail_when: Text, controls, labels, or evidence clip, truncate without recovery, overlap, disappear, or become inoperable.
markers.allowed_exception: Captions and images of text may use applicable WCAG exceptions; recoverable truncation must expose full content nonvisually and on activation or focus.
markers.required_evidence: Before-after screenshots, scale, affected content, and recovery path.

markers.marker: Content or function disappears at a breakpoint
markers.inspection: Compare inventory and task paths across every supported breakpoint and orientation.
markers.fail_when: Required content, proof obligation, control, or comparison is absent or unreachable in one supported state.
markers.allowed_exception: Redundant content may be removed when no unique information or function is lost.
markers.required_evidence: Breakpoint matrix, content inventory, state screenshots, and lost item.

markers.marker: Narrow layout collapses into collisions or unusable density
markers.inspection: Inspect smallest supported width with longest values, all labels, and interactive states visible.
markers.fail_when: Required elements overlap, touch targets merge, lines become unreadable, or grouping becomes ambiguous.
markers.allowed_exception: Dense operational tables may use contained scrolling or alternate views when fully usable.
markers.required_evidence: Narrow viewport, stress content, affected regions, and interaction result.

markers.marker: Longer translated content breaks layout or hides meaning
markers.inspection: Stress labels and paragraphs with declared locale expansion and long unbroken values.
markers.fail_when: Expansion clips, overlaps, misassociates labels, or hides decision-critical content.
markers.allowed_exception: Locale support may be out of scope only when the artifact explicitly declares one language and no localization claim.
markers.required_evidence: Stress strings, expansion factor, language scope, and screenshots.

markers.marker: Right-to-left direction breaks order or meaning
markers.inspection: Render with RTL direction and inspect logical properties, icons, sequences, charts, and mixed-direction values.
markers.fail_when: Reading order, navigation, alignment, directional icons, or data associations become wrong.
markers.allowed_exception: RTL may be out of scope only when the artifact explicitly declares unsupported locales and makes no universal claim.
markers.required_evidence: RTL screenshot, direction-sensitive regions, scope, and findings.

markers.marker: Dense data has no usable narrow-screen strategy
markers.inspection: Review tables, token specimens, matrices, and code at narrow width using keyboard and touch.
markers.fail_when: Users must lose headers, row identity, units, or comparison context to access values.
markers.allowed_exception: Contained scrolling, stacked records, detail disclosure, or alternate views may pass when identity remains visible.
markers.required_evidence: Data region, narrow strategy, input methods, and association test.

markers.marker: Sticky or fixed content consumes or obscures too much viewport
markers.inspection: Measure fixed regions and inspect focus, anchors, and reading at smallest supported viewport.
markers.fail_when: Sticky content hides required material, traps focus, or leaves insufficient working area for the task.
markers.allowed_exception: Temporary modal states may occupy the viewport when focus is contained and dismissal is clear.
markers.required_evidence: Viewport, fixed-region size, obscured targets, and state screenshots.

markers.marker: Verdict appears before the evidence needed to understand it
markers.inspection: Trace first-view and reading sequence from title through evidence, failures, limits, and verdict.
markers.fail_when: A pass or uniqueness claim is visually dominant before its scope, failures, review status, and evidence are available.
markers.allowed_exception: A summary verdict may lead only when status, scope, and direct links to evidence and failures are equally visible.
markers.required_evidence: First viewport, reading order, verdict region, scope region, and evidence access.

markers.marker: Failures or limitations are hidden below passes or decorative content
markers.inspection: Compare visibility, position, contrast, and navigation access of failures, unknowns, and limits against positive claims.
markers.fail_when: A reasonable reader can encounter a pass claim without seeing material failures or scope limits.
markers.allowed_exception: Detailed faults may be collapsed when failure count and severity remain prominent and disclosure is accessible.
markers.required_evidence: Pass and failure regions, first-view state, disclosure behavior, and task path.

markers.marker: No stable scan path
markers.inspection: Review at thumbnail, intended size, and quick five-second exposure; record attention sequence.
markers.fail_when: Readers cannot identify the artifact's subject, status, key evidence, and next detail without searching randomly.
markers.allowed_exception: Exploratory art may use open reading, but a proof artifact must still expose status and evidence paths.
markers.required_evidence: Attention sequence, missed items, scale, and reviewer notes.

markers.marker: Critical and minor information receive equal visual weight
markers.inspection: Rank semantic importance and compare with size, contrast, position, spacing, and repetition.
markers.fail_when: Minor metadata competes with or visually outranks required decisions, warnings, failures, or evidence.
markers.allowed_exception: Uniform data tables may use equal cell treatment when row and column structure preserves priority.
markers.required_evidence: Importance rank, visual rank, mismatches, and regions.

markers.marker: Grouping fails to represent relationships
markers.inspection: Compare proximity, containment, headings, dividers, and repeated anatomy with the content graph.
markers.fail_when: Related items appear separate, unrelated items appear grouped, or parent-child ownership is ambiguous.
markers.allowed_exception: Cross-cutting comparison may intentionally regroup content when the alternate relation is labeled.
markers.required_evidence: Content graph, visual groups, ambiguous items, and labels.

markers.marker: Labels are vague, decorative, duplicated, or inaccurate
markers.inspection: Read each heading, control, legend, and status label without surrounding prose and compare with owned content.
markers.fail_when: A label does not predict its content or action, uses generic filler, or misstates the underlying data.
markers.allowed_exception: Expressive labels may pass when a plain secondary label preserves exact meaning.
markers.required_evidence: Label, owned content, mismatch, and alternate access.

markers.marker: Repeated sections or facts add scanning cost without new value
markers.inspection: Normalize headings and statements; trace every repetition to a distinct task need.
markers.fail_when: The same status, explanation, specimen, or metric repeats without changing scope, comparison, or action.
markers.allowed_exception: Critical warnings may repeat at decision points when the repetition prevents harm or misinterpretation.
markers.required_evidence: Duplicate inventory, locations, task roles, and removal test.

markers.marker: Raw data overwhelms interpretation
markers.inspection: Compare summary, decision, trace, specimen, and raw-record layers; test access for first-use and high-frequency reading tasks.
markers.fail_when: Readers must parse a large unstructured dump to find status, rationale, failures, or token relationships.
markers.allowed_exception: Raw JSON may be included as a secondary inspectable layer when interpretation and search paths are provided.
markers.required_evidence: Layer map, task attempts, time-to-locate results, and raw-data access.

markers.marker: Decoration has no semantic, hierarchical, material, or source-specific function
markers.inspection: Name the role of every oversized shape, line, pattern, gradient, texture, illustration, and flourish, then run a removal test.
markers.fail_when: An element exists only to make the output appear designed and its removal improves clarity without losing identity or meaning.
markers.allowed_exception: Pure ornament may pass when it is source-backed, compositionally controlled, accessible, and does not compete with evidence.
markers.required_evidence: Decoration inventory, claimed roles, removal result, and source locator.

markers.marker: Displayed design does not use the generated tokens it claims to prove
markers.inspection: Compare computed styles and visible specimens with exact token values, aliases, and contextual branches.
markers.fail_when: A material visible value is hardcoded, substituted, or inconsistent with the embedded token system without a documented reason.
markers.allowed_exception: Browser normalization may vary rendered pixels when the semantic token application remains exact and documented.
markers.required_evidence: Region, computed value, token path, resolved value, and variance reason.

markers.marker: Motifs are arbitrary or change meaning across the artifact
markers.inspection: Catalog recurring shapes, lines, image treatments, and motion patterns; map every occurrence to a role.
markers.fail_when: A motif repeats without stable meaning or the same motif signals conflicting roles.
markers.allowed_exception: A motif may vary by context when the transformation rule is visible and documented.
markers.required_evidence: Motif map, occurrences, roles, contradictions, and transformation rule.

markers.marker: Multiple visual systems compete without hierarchy
markers.inspection: Compare type, color, spacing, shape, icon, material, and motion grammars across sections and states.
markers.fail_when: Sections appear authored by unrelated systems and no source-backed hierarchy explains the difference.
markers.allowed_exception: Deliberate juxtaposition may pass when it encodes a required contrast and remains legible.
markers.required_evidence: System clusters, conflicting rules, source rationale, and side-by-side regions.

markers.marker: Repeated cards or tiles are used as a default rather than a content structure
markers.inspection: Remove containers and inspect whether anatomy, comparison, or interaction truly requires separate cards.
markers.fail_when: Most content is boxed uniformly despite different roles, creating monotony, excess chrome, or false equivalence.
markers.allowed_exception: Cards may pass when they represent independent actionable objects with stable anatomy.
markers.required_evidence: Card inventory, object model, removal test, and role differences.

markers.marker: Oversized type or geometry substitutes for hierarchy or identity
markers.inspection: Compare the largest visual events with task priority, source evidence, and information yield.
markers.fail_when: A large gesture dominates without carrying the most important content or source-specific meaning.
markers.allowed_exception: Display scale may pass when it creates the intended first read and does not displace required evidence.
markers.required_evidence: Visual-mass map, task priority, source locator, and first-read test.

markers.marker: Radii, strokes, shadows, icons, or spacing drift without role
markers.inspection: Cluster repeated primitive values and compare outliers with component roles and source variations.
markers.fail_when: Near-duplicate primitives create visible inconsistency and have no semantic or optical justification.
markers.allowed_exception: Optical adjustments may pass when recorded and consistent for the same condition.
markers.required_evidence: Value clusters, outliers, roles, and optical rule.

markers.marker: Density is mismatched to task and evidence volume
markers.inspection: Review information per region, whitespace, target size, scan time, and task familiarity at wide and narrow sizes.
markers.fail_when: The artifact is cramped enough to impair use or sparse enough to fragment relationships and force excessive navigation.
markers.allowed_exception: High-density operational views and low-density focus views may pass with task-specific evidence.
markers.required_evidence: Audience, task, density map, scan result, and responsive states.

markers.marker: Identity survives substitution of product, audience, or brand nouns
markers.inspection: Replace identifying nouns in the thesis and artifact copy with two unrelated domains and review whether the visual system still fits.
markers.fail_when: The direction remains equally plausible after substitution because decisions are generic rather than source-derived.
markers.allowed_exception: Domain-wide conventions may remain when required for comprehension, but signature decisions must still break the substitution.
markers.required_evidence: Two substitutions, resulting fit assessment, and source-specific contradictions.

markers.marker: Material source clause or observed trait is unaccounted for
markers.inspection: Map every source clause and retained observation to applied, rejected, deferred, or not-applicable disposition.
markers.fail_when: Any material clause or trait has no disposition or is replaced by an unsupported assumption.
markers.allowed_exception: Contradictory source items may be rejected only with priority evidence and a recorded reason.
markers.required_evidence: Full accounting table, source locators, dispositions, and conflicts.

markers.marker: Stock scale or familiar default appears without evidence
markers.inspection: Compare token steps, type scale, spacing scale, radii, shadows, and breakpoints with common defaults and source relations.
markers.fail_when: A familiar completed scale is used because it is conventional, not because the source or task supports it.
markers.allowed_exception: A default may pass when independently justified by source measurements, platform constraints, or interoperability needs.
markers.required_evidence: Scale, comparison baseline, source relation, and constraint if any.

markers.marker: Generic semantic roles lack context
markers.inspection: Review role names, descriptions, usage sites, and source links after hiding primitive values.
markers.fail_when: Roles such as primary, secondary, surface, or accent could be transplanted unchanged into unrelated systems.
markers.allowed_exception: Common role names may pass when their graph, values, context branches, and descriptions are source-specific.
markers.required_evidence: Role graph, usage sites, descriptions, and transplant test.

markers.marker: Missing values or categories are completed speculatively
markers.inspection: Trace every generated token and artifact section to source evidence, task necessity, or explicit assumption.
markers.fail_when: The output fills a scale, state, mode, component, or category solely for symmetry or perceived completeness.
markers.allowed_exception: Necessary extrapolation may pass when bounded, labeled, tested, and separated from observed source facts.
markers.required_evidence: Generated item, necessity, evidence or assumption, and validation result.

markers.marker: Run variation is only palette or font substitution
markers.inspection: Compare current and prior artifacts with color, font, and identifying copy removed.
markers.fail_when: Hierarchy, layout, section grammar, specimens, component anatomy, and interaction remain materially unchanged.
markers.allowed_exception: A product family may share structure when the current source explicitly requires that system continuity.
markers.required_evidence: Normalized comparison, shared structure, differing source needs, and continuity evidence.

markers.marker: Headlines or explanations use reusable formulas
markers.inspection: Compare sentence structures, headings, verdict language, and specimen labels against prior artifacts and the source vocabulary.
markers.fail_when: Copy relies on stock phrases, generic praise, repeated headline formulas, or content that could describe unrelated work.
markers.allowed_exception: Stable machine labels may repeat when their semantics and placement are contractually fixed.
markers.required_evidence: Copy patterns, prior matches, source vocabulary, and allowed stable labels.

markers.marker: Audience, product facts, brand traits, or use cases are invented
markers.inspection: Trace every contextual claim to user input, source content, or a clearly labeled assumption.
markers.fail_when: An unsupported context claim drives tokens, design direction, examples, or proof.
markers.allowed_exception: A narrow assumption may pass only when explicitly labeled and when alternate assumptions would not materially change the result.
markers.required_evidence: Claim, source or assumption label, materiality test, and affected decisions.

markers.marker: Pass verdict appears without completed review evidence
markers.inspection: Compare visible verdict and embedded claim fields with required gates, review records, and actual rendered findings.
markers.fail_when: Any pass is recorded while required checks are pending, failed, absent, stale, or based only on claim text.
markers.allowed_exception: No exception; pending or partial work must remain visibly pending or partial.
markers.required_evidence: Verdict field, gate states, review timestamps, render hashes, and unresolved checks.

markers.marker: Reviewed render does not match delivered HTML
markers.inspection: Hash the exact HTML and review captures; compare with embedded and evidence-recorded hashes.
markers.fail_when: Delivered bytes, embedded data, or reviewed captures cannot be tied to the same recorded artifact version.
markers.allowed_exception: A post-review change requires complete reassembly, rerender, and re-review; it is not an exception.
markers.required_evidence: HTML hash, capture hashes, run ID, timestamps, and match result.

markers.marker: Required wide or narrow visual review is missing
markers.inspection: Verify recorded full-page and detail captures for both declared wide and narrow viewports.
markers.fail_when: Either viewport lacks actual rendered inspection or was reviewed before the final artifact hash.
markers.allowed_exception: Additional widths may be not applicable only when no support claim exists; wide and narrow remain mandatory.
markers.required_evidence: Viewport sizes, capture hashes, review times, regions, and artifact hash.

markers.marker: Review uses only whole-page impressions
markers.inspection: Check that high-risk regions, dense data, type, controls, edges, and responsive transformations were inspected at detail scale.
markers.fail_when: No close inspection exists for every risk-bearing region or the review cannot locate its findings.
markers.allowed_exception: No exception for regions carrying required proof, interaction, or dense content.
markers.required_evidence: Region inventory, detail captures, zoom level, and findings.

markers.marker: Review statements are generic or nonlocatable
markers.inspection: Read each finding and attempt to identify its exact viewport, state, region, and observed condition.
markers.fail_when: A finding says clean, polished, coherent, accessible, or unique without concrete locators and evidence.
markers.allowed_exception: A summary may be generic only when it links to the complete located findings that support it.
markers.required_evidence: Finding text, linked observations, locators, and supporting measurements.

markers.marker: Evidence lacks source or artifact locators
markers.inspection: Validate that every observation, decision, failure, pass, and limitation names its source and artifact location.
markers.fail_when: A material judgment cannot be traced to exact source evidence and an exact rendered region or token path.
markers.allowed_exception: Whole-frame judgments may use the full viewport as a region but must still name the viewport and state.
markers.required_evidence: Trace table with source, token, artifact, viewport, and state locators.

markers.marker: Static or machine checks are presented as visual certification
markers.inspection: Separate machine outputs from native visual findings and inspect who or what supplied each judgment.
markers.fail_when: A linter, DOM detector, hash, screenshot existence, or automated score is treated as proof of good visual design.
markers.allowed_exception: Machine checks may prove only their measured property and may support, never replace, visual judgment.
markers.required_evidence: Check inventory, claimed scope, visual reviewer record, and separation statement.

markers.marker: Visible proof disagrees with embedded tokens or evidence
markers.inspection: Parse embedded records and compare counts, values, statuses, hashes, limitations, and displayed claims.
markers.fail_when: Any visible material fact differs from the embedded canonical record or omits a recorded failure.
markers.allowed_exception: Presentation rounding may pass when exact values remain accessible and the rounding rule is disclosed.
markers.required_evidence: Field paths, visible values, embedded values, comparison result, and rounding rule.

markers.marker: Standalone artifact depends on external runtime resources
markers.inspection: Block network access and inspect HTML for external scripts, styles, fonts, images, frames, imports, and fetches.
markers.fail_when: Required content, style, interaction, or proof fails offline or any undeclared external request is required.
markers.allowed_exception: User-clicked source links may be external when the artifact remains complete and usable offline.
markers.required_evidence: Network log, resource inventory, offline render, and allowed links.

markers.marker: Runtime script error or rejected promise
markers.inspection: Load and exercise every interaction while recording console errors and rejected promises.
markers.fail_when: Any error affects content, interaction, evidence access, state, or reviewer confidence.
markers.allowed_exception: Benign browser-extension errors are excluded when proven external to the artifact.
markers.required_evidence: Console log, stack, action, affected behavior, and origin.

markers.marker: Invalid or malformed markup changes structure or accessibility
markers.inspection: Parse with an HTML conformance checker and compare corrected DOM with intended ownership and order.
markers.fail_when: Parsing errors change nesting, labels, tables, headings, controls, or embedded data boundaries.
markers.allowed_exception: Non-impacting warnings may remain when documented and verified across target browsers.
markers.required_evidence: Validator output, corrected DOM comparison, browser set, and impact finding.

markers.marker: Viewport configuration breaks mobile scaling
markers.inspection: Inspect viewport metadata and render on a mobile-sized browser at default scale.
markers.fail_when: The page renders at a desktop layout width, disables needed zoom, or causes unintended scaling.
markers.allowed_exception: No exception for an artifact claiming responsive mobile or narrow support.
markers.required_evidence: Viewport metadata, device metrics, default-scale screenshot, and zoom behavior.

markers.marker: Missing or inaccurate language, title, encoding, or document outline
markers.inspection: Inspect document metadata, heading hierarchy, landmarks, and parsed text encoding.
markers.fail_when: Language or title is missing or wrong, characters corrupt, or the outline misrepresents the artifact.
markers.allowed_exception: No material exception; concise metadata is sufficient when accurate.
markers.required_evidence: Metadata values, outline, encoding test, and mismatch list.

markers.marker: Artifact is too slow or heavy for its proof task
markers.inspection: Measure local load, script work, memory, animation cost, and interaction response on a declared baseline device.
markers.fail_when: Delay prevents timely evidence access, causes input lag, or makes visual review unreliable.
markers.allowed_exception: Large embedded evidence may pass when loading is progressive, interactions remain responsive, and size is justified.
markers.required_evidence: Baseline device, byte size, timings, memory, interaction latency, and justification.

markers.marker: DOM or repeated markup is disproportionate to content
markers.inspection: Count nodes, depth, repeated structures, hidden duplicates, and event handlers; compare with evidence volume.
markers.fail_when: Excess structure creates measurable slowness, duplicate reading, maintenance risk, or hidden conflicting content.
markers.allowed_exception: Large token inventories may require many nodes when progressive disclosure and performance remain sound.
markers.required_evidence: Node count, depth, duplicates, timings, and content ratio.

markers.marker: Print or export loses required proof when that output is claimed
markers.inspection: Render declared print or export output and inspect pagination, colors, links, overflow, and embedded data access.
markers.fail_when: Required evidence clips, disappears, splits unintelligibly, or changes status in the declared export.
markers.allowed_exception: Print may be out of scope only when no print, PDF, or archival claim is made.
markers.required_evidence: Declared support, rendered pages, affected regions, and comparison with screen.

markers.marker: Unsupported or contradicted factual claim
markers.inspection: Trace every factual statement, metric, date, audience fact, and source interpretation to evidence.
markers.fail_when: A fact has no source, conflicts with source evidence, or is presented with stronger certainty than available evidence.
markers.allowed_exception: A clearly labeled hypothesis may remain when it does not support a passing claim.
markers.required_evidence: Claim, source, locator, confidence, contradiction check, and disposition.

markers.marker: Duplicate or near-duplicate descriptions imply false breadth
markers.inspection: Normalize visible descriptions, labels, and rationales; compare semantic duplicates and token ownership.
markers.fail_when: Multiple items repeat the same idea without distinct roles, evidence, or context.
markers.allowed_exception: Repeated legal or safety text may remain when exact repetition is required.
markers.required_evidence: Duplicate clusters, locations, role comparison, and required repetitions.

markers.marker: Missing, wrong, or ambiguous unit
markers.inspection: Compare visible numeric values with DTCG value types, units, contexts, and resolved aliases.
markers.fail_when: A reader can misinterpret magnitude, duration, angle, dimension, percentage, or color because units are absent or wrong.
markers.allowed_exception: Unitless values may omit a unit only when the DTCG type and visible label make that explicit.
markers.required_evidence: Visible value, token path, DTCG type, expected unit, and correction.

markers.marker: Visible label, value, or state disagrees with canonical data
markers.inspection: Resolve token aliases and compare all displayed paths, descriptions, values, types, and statuses with embedded JSON.
markers.fail_when: A displayed specimen or claim mislabels, rounds materially, or shows a different value or state.
markers.allowed_exception: Declared display formatting may pass when exact canonical data remains directly accessible.
markers.required_evidence: Canonical field, visible field, resolver output, formatting rule, and match result.

markers.marker: Truncation hides identity, decision, status, unit, or evidence
markers.inspection: Stress with longest real values and inspect ellipses, clamps, tooltips, copy, and focus access.
markers.fail_when: The hidden portion can change meaning and no accessible reliable path reveals the full content.
markers.allowed_exception: Redundant low-priority text may truncate when full content is available on focus or activation and indicated nonvisually.
markers.required_evidence: Full value, visible value, state, recovery path, and assistive access.

markers.marker: Metric, score, chart, or percentage lacks a defined computation
markers.inspection: Trace every quantitative display to inputs, formula, threshold, run record, and reproducible output.
markers.fail_when: A number is decorative, invented, unreproducible, or gives false precision to a judgment.
markers.allowed_exception: Illustrative data may appear only when visibly labeled as an example and excluded from proof.
markers.required_evidence: Metric definition, inputs, formula, output, threshold, and example label if used.

markers.marker: Language is vague, inflated, repetitive, or internally inconsistent
markers.inspection: Read visible content for specific referents, stable terminology, evidence-bearing statements, and contradiction.
markers.fail_when: Claims rely on praise without facts, repeat formulas, switch terms, or obscure limits and actions.
markers.allowed_exception: Expressive copy may pass when exact machine labels and proof statements remain clear.
markers.required_evidence: Problem phrases, referents, terminology map, and revised meaning test.

markers.marker: Embedded canonical data is altered, incomplete, or unparsable
markers.inspection: Extract embedded JSON, parse it, hash it, and compare with source token and evidence files byte-for-byte or by declared canonicalization.
markers.fail_when: Data cannot be parsed, required fields are missing, or hashes and values differ without a declared transformation.
markers.allowed_exception: Escaping and deterministic canonicalization may differ at byte level when decoded data matches exactly.
markers.required_evidence: Source hashes, embedded hashes, decoded comparison, canonicalization method, and result.

markers.marker: Exact artifact or token output collides with corpus item
markers.inspection: Hash exact outputs and compare with every item in the declared corpus.
markers.fail_when: Any exact hash matches a different recorded item or run.
markers.allowed_exception: The same run or an explicitly versioned byte-identical copy is not a uniqueness candidate and must be labeled as such.
markers.required_evidence: Corpus manifest, hashes, run IDs, collision, and copy disposition.

markers.marker: Normalized token graph collides after metadata removal
markers.inspection: Normalize ordering, descriptions, run IDs, and file metadata, then compare path-role-reference-value graphs.
markers.fail_when: A graph matches a prior item despite renamed groups, reordered keys, or changed metadata.
markers.allowed_exception: Shared mandated primitives may collide only when the overall semantic and contextual graph remains materially distinct.
markers.required_evidence: Normalization method, graph hashes, shared subgraphs, and final collision result.

markers.marker: Layout skeleton repeats across artifacts
markers.inspection: Remove color, font, copy, decoration, and run metadata; compare regions, order, hierarchy, containment, and responsive transformations.
markers.fail_when: The same shell persists and current differences are surface substitutions rather than source-driven structure.
markers.allowed_exception: A shared family shell may pass only when explicitly required and when content anatomy and signature regions still differ materially.
markers.required_evidence: Normalized skeletons, distances, nearest neighbor, source requirements, and reviewer comparison.

markers.marker: Visual nearest neighbor is too similar
markers.inspection: Compare full-color, grayscale, edge-map, hierarchy map, and region embeddings against predeclared thresholds.
markers.fail_when: Similarity exceeds the frozen threshold on multiple structural axes or a blind reviewer confuses the items.
markers.allowed_exception: Shared mandated brand foundations may match when source-specific composition and content remain distinguishable.
markers.required_evidence: Methods, thresholds, distances, nearest-neighbor images, and blind review.

markers.marker: Difference from nearest neighbor is mainly hue
markers.inspection: Compare in grayscale and with typography and identifying nouns masked.
markers.fail_when: Hierarchy, composition, density, component anatomy, and specimen grammar remain the same.
markers.allowed_exception: Color-system studies may focus on hue only when that narrow purpose is explicit and no uniqueness claim extends beyond it.
markers.required_evidence: Color and grayscale comparisons, masked comparison, and claim scope.

markers.marker: Headline and section-copy formulas repeat across runs
markers.inspection: Normalize nouns and compare syntax, cadence, section order, labels, and verdict phrasing with corpus artifacts.
markers.fail_when: The current artifact uses the same content grammar with substituted nouns or adjectives.
markers.allowed_exception: Machine obligations and legal limits may use stable labels when the authored narrative remains run-specific.
markers.required_evidence: Normalized copy patterns, matches, allowed labels, and current-source vocabulary.

markers.marker: Token specimen strategy repeats regardless of token meaning
markers.inspection: Compare how colors, dimensions, type, motion, gradients, shadows, borders, assets, strokes, and composites are demonstrated across runs.
markers.fail_when: Every type is forced into the same card, row, swatch, or tile treatment and prior artifacts use the same grammar.
markers.allowed_exception: A stable raw-data table may repeat as a secondary machine-readable layer, not as the authored proof experience.
markers.required_evidence: Specimen map by type, prior comparison, semantic fit, and secondary-layer boundary.

markers.marker: Similarity threshold was chosen or changed after seeing results
markers.inspection: Inspect run-state ordering, threshold timestamps, revisions, approvals, and comparison timestamps.
markers.fail_when: A threshold is absent before comparison or is relaxed after results without an approved scope change and rerun.
markers.allowed_exception: A faulty method may be replaced when the reason is recorded before rerunning and old and new results remain visible.
markers.required_evidence: Frozen threshold record, timestamps, method version, revisions, approval, and rerun.

markers.marker: Applicable state is omitted from inventory or review
markers.inspection: Enumerate component, interaction, data, responsive, mode, motion, and failure states from inputs and token possibilities.
markers.fail_when: Any applicable state has no applied, rejected, deferred, or not-applicable disposition and no rendered review.
markers.allowed_exception: A state may be not applicable only with source or product-logic evidence.
markers.required_evidence: State universe, dispositions, source logic, rendered states, and coverage ratio.

markers.marker: Hover, focus, active, selected, visited, or pressed state is missing or inconsistent
markers.inspection: Exercise every interactive component through every applicable input method and state.
markers.fail_when: A state is absent, indistinguishable, misleading, or visually outside the component grammar.
markers.allowed_exception: States that cannot occur for the component may be excluded with an explicit interaction-model reason.
markers.required_evidence: Component-state matrix, input method, screenshots, and exclusions.

markers.marker: Disabled, read-only, unavailable, or permission state is ambiguous
markers.inspection: Compare availability states with enabled controls and inspect contrast, labels, cursor, focus, and explanatory text.
markers.fail_when: Users cannot tell whether an item is actionable or why it is unavailable.
markers.allowed_exception: A control may be omitted instead of disabled when task logic and layout remain clear.
markers.required_evidence: State comparison, reason communication, interaction result, and omission logic.

markers.marker: Empty, loading, partial, error, success, or stale-data state is missing
markers.inspection: Render every applicable data-lifecycle state with real-length content and recovery actions.
markers.fail_when: A state shows blank space, fake data, indefinite loading, dead ends, or a layout unlike the normal system.
markers.allowed_exception: Static proof sections may omit live lifecycle states when they make no interactive data claim.
markers.required_evidence: Lifecycle matrix, screenshots, recovery paths, and static-scope declaration.

markers.marker: Long, short, empty, repeated, or malformed values were not stress-tested
markers.inspection: Render minimum, maximum, unbroken, multiline, duplicate, null, and invalid content where applicable.
markers.fail_when: Any stress case clips, overlaps, hides ownership, corrupts layout, or produces misleading placeholders.
markers.allowed_exception: Schema-impossible values may be excluded with validator evidence.
markers.required_evidence: Stress cases, schema limits, screenshots, and outcomes.

markers.marker: Declared theme, density, platform, locale, or context mode lacks full review
markers.inspection: Cross the declared mode set with components, token branches, and required viewports.
markers.fail_when: Any supported mode has missing tokens, incomplete styling, contrast faults, or an unrelated visual identity.
markers.allowed_exception: Unsupported modes must be clearly out of scope and absent from claims.
markers.required_evidence: Mode matrix, token branches, screenshots, failures, and scope.

markers.marker: Motion start, middle, end, interrupted, and reduced states are incomplete
markers.inspection: Review motion frame-by-frame, interrupt it, change focus, and enable reduced motion.
markers.fail_when: Content becomes unreadable, state ownership is lost, interruption breaks layout, or the final state differs from the intended value.
markers.allowed_exception: No-motion artifacts may mark motion states not applicable when no motion token or behavior is claimed.
markers.required_evidence: Motion timeline, interruption steps, reduced state, and frame captures.

markers.marker: Required token permutation is unaccounted for
markers.inspection: Generate the applicability matrix across token type, role, state, mode, component, context, and source intent, then review retained cells.
markers.fail_when: An applicable permutation is silently omitted or represented only by raw JSON without a proof strategy.
markers.allowed_exception: Collapsed equivalence classes may pass when members are provably identical in behavior and the representative rule is recorded.
markers.required_evidence: Permutation universe, applicability rules, equivalence classes, rendered representatives, and coverage ratio.

markers.marker: Placeholder, lorem, TODO, sample, fake, or demo content remains
markers.inspection: Search source and rendered content, then visually inspect blank, repeated, suspicious, and low-information regions.
markers.fail_when: Any placeholder or fabricated production-looking content appears outside a clearly labeled negative or illustrative example.
markers.allowed_exception: Test fixtures may contain placeholders only when the artifact is visibly labeled as a test and excluded from passing precedent.
markers.required_evidence: Search results, visible regions, labels, and fixture boundary.

markers.marker: Debug UI, guides, outlines, logs, IDs, or developer controls leak into the artifact
markers.inspection: Inspect every viewport and state for diagnostic layers, raw errors, internal paths, and temporary controls.
markers.fail_when: Internal tooling distracts, exposes private data, changes layout, or can be mistaken for proof content.
markers.allowed_exception: A dedicated technical-evidence disclosure may include diagnostics when labeled, sanitized, and secondary.
markers.required_evidence: Diagnostic item, location, data sensitivity, role, and disclosure state.

markers.marker: Local path, expiring URL, or environment-only asset breaks portability
markers.inspection: Move or copy the file to an isolated directory, block network access, and open it in a fresh browser profile.
markers.fail_when: Any required resource, link target within the artifact, or embedded data depends on the authoring environment.
markers.allowed_exception: External citation links may require network access when the artifact itself remains complete offline.
markers.required_evidence: Isolation path, resource log, offline screenshot, and allowed citations.

markers.marker: Claimed browser support is unverified or visibly inconsistent
markers.inspection: Render and interact in every declared browser engine or reduce the support claim.
markers.fail_when: A declared browser has missing styles, broken behavior, layout drift, or inaccessible controls.
markers.allowed_exception: Support may be limited to a named browser set when stated in the artifact and request.
markers.required_evidence: Browser versions, screenshots, interaction results, and declared set.

markers.marker: Link, anchor, disclosure, copy control, or navigation action fails
markers.inspection: Activate every control by keyboard and pointer, including fragment links and repeated interactions.
markers.fail_when: An action is dead, targets the wrong content, loses focus, copies the wrong value, or changes proof state unexpectedly.
markers.allowed_exception: Noninteractive visual labels must not appear actionable.
markers.required_evidence: Control inventory, activation method, expected result, actual result, and focus result.

markers.marker: Mouse, touch, and keyboard produce materially different access
markers.inspection: Complete the same required tasks with each supported input method.
markers.fail_when: One method cannot reach, reveal, dismiss, scroll, compare, or copy required content.
markers.allowed_exception: Input-specific enhancements may differ when all required outcomes remain equivalent.
markers.required_evidence: Task list, input methods, completion results, and differences.

markers.marker: File name, title, run ID, hashes, or artifact identity disagree
markers.inspection: Compare file metadata, document title, embedded run record, visible identity, and output manifest.
markers.fail_when: A reviewer cannot unambiguously tie the file to its token and evidence inputs.
markers.allowed_exception: Human-friendly titles may differ from filenames when the stable run ID and hashes agree.
markers.required_evidence: Filename, title, run ID, token hash, evidence hash, artifact hash, and manifest.

markers.marker: Saved, copied, printed, or archived result differs from reviewed state
markers.inspection: Exercise every claimed output action and compare resulting bytes or pixels with the reviewed artifact.
markers.fail_when: Export omits content, changes values, breaks layout, or cannot be linked to the reviewed run.
markers.allowed_exception: Unclaimed export paths may remain out of scope.
markers.required_evidence: Claimed actions, output hashes, visual comparison, and run linkage.

markers.marker: Current claim relies on stale or undated evidence
markers.inspection: Compare claim date, source verification date, run anchor, standard version, and the drift risk of each fact.
markers.fail_when: A fact presented as current was not freshly checked despite material chance of change.
markers.allowed_exception: Stable historical facts may use older evidence when explicitly dated and not presented as current.
markers.required_evidence: Claim, evidence date, run date, drift assessment, and current verification result.

markers.marker: Run lacks one fresh local date anchor
markers.inspection: Validate the run record contains exactly one valid anchor acquired after the request and before date-sensitive work.
markers.fail_when: Anchor is missing, duplicated, malformed, stale, fabricated, or acquired after date-sensitive decisions.
markers.allowed_exception: No exception for a run making current-source, current-standard, or date-sensitive claims.
markers.required_evidence: Anchor JSON, acquisition time, request time, timezone, and stage order.

markers.marker: Evidence is future-dated relative to the run anchor
markers.inspection: Parse all evidence and source timestamps and compare with the run anchor and timezone.
markers.fail_when: Any evidence timestamp is later than the run without a documented timezone correction or scheduled-state label.
markers.allowed_exception: Planned future dates may appear as plans, never as completed evidence.
markers.required_evidence: Run anchor, evidence timestamps, timezones, corrections, and planned labels.

markers.marker: Drift-prone source was not freshly verified
markers.inspection: Identify standards, product behavior, design research, AI research, and policies with material drift risk; check primary sources on the run date.
markers.fail_when: A drift-prone claim relies on recall, old notes, secondary summaries, or an unverified pinned copy.
markers.allowed_exception: Offline operation may mark the claim blocked or historical, but cannot present it as current.
markers.required_evidence: Claim inventory, drift class, primary URL, checked date, and blocked items.

markers.marker: Pinned conformance version is confused with current research or runtime state
markers.inspection: Compare DTCG schema version, current research dates, runtime behavior, and visible wording.
markers.fail_when: The artifact implies that a pinned standard is the newest version without verification or applies current behavior to an older schema.
markers.allowed_exception: A pinned version may be used intentionally when labeled as pinned and separated from current-source claims.
markers.required_evidence: Pinned version, current check, visible labels, and conformance target.

markers.marker: Visible, embedded, and filesystem timestamps disagree materially
markers.inspection: Compare run record, evidence, embedded proof, review captures, manifest, and artifact modification times.
markers.fail_when: Ordering becomes impossible, review appears to precede assembly, or the visible date misstates the run.
markers.allowed_exception: Filesystem copy times may differ when canonical run timestamps and hashes preserve lineage.
markers.required_evidence: Timestamp table, timezone, ordering, copy explanation, and hashes.

markers.marker: Review uses superseded thresholds or misstates a current standard
markers.inspection: Verify normative thresholds against the current official source while preserving the requested pinned conformance target.
markers.fail_when: A threshold is obsolete, cited to a nonauthoritative source, or applied outside its defined scope.
markers.allowed_exception: A stricter internal target may be used when labeled as such and not attributed to the standard.
markers.required_evidence: Official URL, checked date, exact criterion, applied scope, and internal targets.

markers.marker: Time-limited evidence has no validity boundary
markers.inspection: Review live-site captures, expiring links, mutable corpora, runtime versions, and product-state evidence for validity windows.
markers.fail_when: Mutable evidence is presented as indefinitely valid or reused after a material state change without recheck.
markers.allowed_exception: Immutable hashed local sources may remain valid for what their bytes prove.
markers.required_evidence: Evidence item, mutability, captured date, validity rule, hash, and recheck trigger.

markers.marker: Observed harmful visual condition is not represented elsewhere in the catalog
markers.inspection: Record the exact visible condition, affected task or meaning, repeatability, causal evidence, and why existing markers do not cover it.
markers.fail_when: The reviewer can locate a repeatable condition that harms comprehension, access, fidelity, trust, or task completion and cannot map it to an existing marker.
markers.allowed_exception: A novel stylistic preference without demonstrated harm remains a taste-track question, not an unknown defect.
markers.required_evidence: Viewport, state, region, screenshots, harm mechanism, repeatability, existing-marker comparison, and proposed new marker.

standards_basis.title: Understanding Three Flashes or Below Threshold
